# Namesake

> Personalised bedtime audio stories, created and approved by a parent before listening.

Namesake creates original AI stories using a child profile, interests, companions and a parent-selected idea. Parents can review and edit the text before approval. Narrated listening can continue with the phone screen off. New stories require internet; offline playback requires downloaded audio. Story languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Dutch. Optional recorded-voice narration is still being developed.

## Product and access

- [Namesake website](https://trynamesake.com/): Product examples and current access information.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://trynamesake.com/faq.html): Creation, parent review, listening and data.
- [Privacy](https://trynamesake.com/privacy.html)
